The '''Faruun''' were an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of ship-builders from [[Firefist]], a satellite galaxy of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
[[File:Nagai6.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Nagai fleet built by the Faruun.]]

The Faruun lived in [[Firefist]], a satellite galaxy near the south-west quadrant of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were conquered by the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]], a species of giant and brutal [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. Faruun refugees eventually allied with other groups conquered by the Tofs, in particular the pale [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and the cyborg [[Maccabree]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

The Faruun provided a [[Nagai expeditionary force|fleet]] for their allies, and with the guidance of the cyborg [[Lumiya]], they fled Firefist and their Tof overlords. Their plan was to conquer parts of the galaxy from the exhausted parties in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], build up their strength and then return to Firefist to destroy the Tofs.<ref name="Atlas83" />

The Faruun starships designs were characterized by a marked individuality influenced by their Nagai allies, with no two ships alike. Though this was similar to the design philosophy of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], the Faruun-Nagai vessels were easily identified with a high amount of chrome finishes on their hulls. They were also fitted with Nagai technology and employed [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]] made by the Nagai [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kruskob Tiltanka]]. In honor of their [[Nagi/Legends|homeworld]], the capital ships were named after cities on Nagi.<ref name="TFW">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref>
